shortDescription: This module manages snapshots (PiT image of a volume) on IBM Spectrum Virtualize family storage systems

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: ignorelegacy
options.description: Specifies the addition of the volume snapshots although there are already legacy FlashCopy mappings using the volume as a source.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of a snapshot.

options.name: old_name
options.description: Specifies the old name of a snapshot. Valid when I(state=present), to rename the existing snapshot.

options.name: ownershipgroup
options.description: Specifies the name of the ownershipgroup. Valid when I(state=present), to update an existing snapshot.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: retentiondays
options.description: Specifies the retention period in days. I(safeguarded) and I(retentiondays) are required together. Applies, when I(state=present) to create a safeguarded snapshot.

options.name: safeguarded
options.description: Flag to create a safeguarded snapshot. I(safeguarded) and I(retentiondays) are required together. Supported in SV build 8.5.2.0 or later.

options.name: snapshot_pool
options.description: Specifies the name of child pool within which the snapshot is being created.

options.name: src_volume_names
options.description: Specifies the name of the volumes for which the snapshots are to be created. List of volume names can be specified with the delimiter colon. Valid when I(state=present), to create a snapshot.

options.name: src_volumegroup_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the source volume group for which the snapshot is being created. I(src_volumegroup_name) and I(src_volume_names) are mutually exclusive. Required one of I(src_volumegroup_name) or I(src_volume_names) for creation of snapshot.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates, updates (C(present)) or deletes (C(absent)) a snapshot.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.spectrum_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.
